reason: The plan hits every hard requirement (12 steps, backup before destructive steps, dry run, rollback, stakeholder comms, integrity check) with technically sound PostgreSQL-specific detail, but it re-enables read-write traffic in step 8 before running integrity verification in step 9, undermining verification as a safety gate, and cites pg_checksums (a page-corruption tool) somewhat imprecisely as a cross-instance integrity check.
